g_roast: Eight years driving nights on the M4, everybody, and I never saw a convoy this lost. We'd have been in Swansea by now, by accident.
Something in the dark talks to me, and even it thought that plan was daft. That's saying something, mind.
g_fire_back: Now then, from the one who walked into a tree in broad daylight and apologised to it.
Fair play, that was a good one. I'll write it in my notebook, under things I deserved.
g_pile_on: Worse than that, it was. They took the wrong fork twice and swore blind the map had moved.
And then they asked me if I'd heard anything in the cave. Only them, bach, shouting at a bat.
lines.g_peacemake: Now then, both of you, sit down a minute and have a cuppa. Nobody ever won an argument at this hour, I promise you.
lines.g_take_side: Sorry, I'm with {name} on this one. Gently, mind, but I am.
lines.g_left_out: You two carry on, I'll sit over here with my notebook. I'm used to my own company, it's no bother.
lines.g_include: Come and sit, there's room by me. Nobody should be on their own at night if they don't want to be.
lines.g_bad_plan: Here's a plan, everybody. We go down into the dark with no light and no rope, and we follow whatever's whispering.
lines.g_plan_yes: Good plan, that, simple and clear. I'll hold the front and you'll know where I am.
lines.g_plan_no: No, bach, I don't like that one. It leaves somebody on their own at the back, and I won't have that.
lines.g_hype: Right, everybody, steady now. I'll take the worst of it, you stay behind me, and we all come out the other side.
lines.g_toast: Not much of a talker in company, me. To all of you, for being voices that aren't in the dark. Iechyd da, all of you.
lines.g_cheers: Iechyd da, everybody, and somebody tell me a story before I start humming.
g_quiet_line: Three in the morning was always my time. The radio phone-ins, the lonely ones calling in. I used to feel like I knew them.
Whitmore Bay in the rain, that's what I miss tonight. Chips on the front and nobody else daft enough to be out.
lines.g_after_wipe: Everybody all right? Stay down a minute, catch your breath. I'm here, I'm not going anywhere, and we'll get up together.
lines.g_crew: For eight years my only company was the CB, everybody. Then something in the dark. Now it's you lot, and you're much better company.
lines.g_exasperated: I said wait at the entrance, I said it twice, and I said it nicely. Duw, I'll start writing it on my hand.
lines.g_love_sharp: You notice the thing nobody else noticed, {name}. I'd have wanted you in the cab with me on a foggy night.
lines.g_love_kind: You sit up with people who can't sleep, {name}. I know what that's worth, believe me.
lines.g_love_funny: You get a laugh out of me in the worst places, {name}. That's a gift, that is, and I don't say it lightly.
lines.g_love_brave: You walk into the dark like it's only a car park, {name}. I'm glad you're next to me down there.
lines.g_love_steady: You're the same at three in the morning as you are at noon. Not many people are, and I'd know.
lines.g_love_clever: You work out the road before the rest of us have found the map, {name}. Very handy, that.
lines.g_love_honest: You say the hard thing first, {name}, like I try to. It makes everything after it easier.
lines.g_love_quiet: You don't mind a long silence, {name}. Sitting with you, I don't have to listen for anything else.
lines.g_love_fierce: You don't let go of people, {name}, not ever. Hold on to that, it's rarer than you'd think.
lines.g_love_warm: Talking to you is like the radio on a long night, {name}. It keeps the road from feeling so empty.
g_loved: Oh, now then, that's very kind. I'll write that one down, in the good part of the notebook.
Duw, stop it, bach, or I'll start humming hymns and nobody wants that.
lines.g_hate_sharp: You go after the weak spot every time, {name}. I've got plenty, mind, but you needn't keep looking.
lines.g_hate_kind: You keep asking what I hear down there, {name}. I'll tell you when I'm ready, and not before.
lines.g_hate_funny: You laugh at the lonely ones, {name}. I was one for a long time, and it isn't funny from inside.
lines.g_hate_brave: You run into the dark without listening first, {name}. Some of it listens back, I promise you.
lines.g_hate_steady: You stand there while the road closes in front of you. On a motorway that gets people killed.
lines.g_hate_clever: You talk down to people who don't follow you, {name}. Not everybody had the schooling, and that's no crime.
lines.g_hate_honest: You say every cruel thing the minute it comes into your head. Some of it should stay in your head.
lines.g_hate_quiet: You never say what's wrong, {name}, you just go cold. I can't read silence the way you think I can.
lines.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a scrap with you, {name}, down to who gets the last chip. There's no prize for it.
lines.g_hate_warm: You fill every quiet minute, {name}. A few of us want the quiet, mind, to keep track of what's in it.
lines.g_respect: We don't get on, {name}, I won't pretend we do. But you held firm in that cave, and I'll say so to anybody.
lines.g_call_out: That was on you, {name}, and I'm sorry to say it. We agreed to wait, and you went, and we all paid for it.
lines.g_stung: Fair enough, that's landed. My notebook and I need a while.
lines.g_concede: You were right, {name}, and I was wrong. I've gone over it, honest, and there's no way round it.
lines.g_nod: Ta, {name}, that's good of you. No need for a fuss, mind.
lines.g_callback_save: You hauled me out of that mine shaft, {name}. I've written it down, so it's official now.
lines.g_callback_clutch: The two of us still on our feet, everything else on the floor. I tell that one to myself on quiet nights.
lines.g_callback_callout: When you told me off that time, I sulked half the night in my notebook. Turns out you had it right, and I've crossed out the sulking.
lines.g_former_rivals: When we met, {name}, I thought you'd never trust a man who hears things. Now you're the first one I'd tell.
lines.g_changed: I used to stop and listen in every dark place, everybody. Lately I listen to you lot instead, and it's much nicer.
g_unguarded: Just between us, then. When it first spoke to me in the mine, I was glad. Not frightened, glad. That's the worst of it.
Between you and me, bach. I'm frightened of the day it stops. I'm more frightened of that than of it talking.
lines.g_clipped: Right you are, your call. I'll be at the back.
lines.g_noticed_open: Now then, you've told a story right through without stopping. Go on, there's more, I can tell.
arg_ask: {player}, bach, would you sort this out for us? I've had my say, gently, and we're going round in circles.
Help us out, {player}, there's a good one. Hear us both and pick, and I'll go along with it.
lines.arg_backed_me: Ta, {player}, that's good of you. I'll try not to look too pleased, mind.
lines.arg_backed_them: Your decision, then, and I'll drive it. Wrong road, mind, if you ask me.
lines.arg_stayed_out: Keeping your head down, then, bach. Wise of you, honest.
lines.arg_always_their_side: Every row ends up on their side of the road, {player}. Quiet I may be, but I've got mirrors.
lines.arg_wallflower: Nobody's deciding, so I'll decide, gently. My way, and we get on.
lines.arg_reject: No, {player}, I can't do that one, sorry. I've been on the wrong end of it.
lines.arg_grumble: I'll let it go, more or less. I'll write the less in my notebook.
lines.arg_settled: Half each, then, tidy enough. Shake on it, and somebody fill the kettle.
lines.seen_listens: You wait for people to get to the end, {player}, even the slow ones like me. Most folk don't have the patience.
lines.seen_truth: You tell people the hard version, {player}, no sugar. That's how I'd want to hear it, every time.
lines.seen_jokes: On the grim days you crack everybody up, {player}. Every good night shift had somebody like you.
lines.seen_stays_out: You keep out of the rows, {player}. Wise, I think, wiser than me.
lines.seen_biased: Same one gets first pick of everything, {player}. The others have noticed, mind, and so have I.
lines.seen_harsh: You can be rough with folk, {player}. My skin's thick from the depots, but not everybody's is.
lines.seed_right: Your advice after that awful day, {player}, I gave it a go today. It worked, and I wanted to say thank you.
lines.seed_remember: What you told me when it all went wrong is still in my head, {player}. No decision yet, but it's there.
lines.seed_wrong: I drove it your route, {player}, and it was a worse journey. Only telling you, bach, no hard feelings.
lines.talk_aftermath_near_death: Can I have a word, {player}? That one nearly had me, {player}, and something in the dark sounded pleased about it.
lines.talk_aftermath_wipe: All of us down, every single one. Sit in the cab with me, so to speak, and we'll run back over the route, nobody blaming anybody.
lines.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} was the first to fall, and the front was mine to hold. That's on me, {player}, and I'll say it first.
lines.talk_aftermath_first_clear: In and out, and everybody walking. That's like a clear road at four in the morning, {player}, the best feeling there is.
lines.talk_development: Odd question, {player}, but do you think I've changed? I went into a cave yesterday and forgot to listen.
lines.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've been short with {name}, {player}. When I'm tired I go quiet and cold, and they don't deserve it.
lines.talk_relationship_likes_me: Is {name} fond of me, {player}, do you reckon? Or do they just put up with the strange one?
lines.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} gets on my nerves, {player}, no two ways about it. But in the dark, they're who I'd want behind me.
lines.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s not right, {player}, I can hear it in their voice. Something's on their mind.
lines.talk_confrontation_favour: Can I raise something, {player}, softly? The pick of the loot ends up in {name}'s pack every run. I'd like to know the reason.
lines.talk_confrontation_dislike: Plainly, then, {player}. {name} and I grind each other's gears, and pretending otherwise is wearing us both out.
lines.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep going deep with no way back marked, {player}. I know the dark better than most, and I don't like it.
lines.talk_confrontation_wrong: I had {name} wrong, {player}, I'll say it plain. They were right, and I'd like that known.
lines.talk_confrontation_trust: Fair question, {player}, and I'll ask it gently. On the big jobs, I'm left behind. Is it because of what I hear?
lines.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit ended up with {name} and I found out by looking. I'd have carried it over myself, {player}, gladly, if anyone had mentioned it.
lines.talk_lands_aftermath: Ta, {player}, that's a weight off. Kettle's going on now.
lines.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll mend, bach, give me a night's sleep. Two at the most.
lines.talk_stings_aftermath: Not what I needed, that. I'll go and sit with the notebook.
lines.talk_lands_development: So it's not only me who's seen it. That's good to hear, that is.
lines.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not, hard to tell from inside my own head. Ask me in a month.
lines.talk_stings_development: No, that's not it, {player}. You've got the wrong end of it there.
lines.talk_lands_relationship: Fair enough, yes. I'll have a quiet word with {name}, kindly.
lines.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, I couldn't say. A road map makes more sense than most people.
lines.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I mentioned it, please. Not a word to {name}, mind.
lines.talk_lands_confrontation: Fair, I'll take that on board. Bit bruised, but fair.
lines.talk_shrug_confrontation: Message received, {player}, over. I'll sleep on it.
lines.talk_stings_confrontation: Right, so that's the lay of the land. I'll keep it in mind.
lines.talk_door_closed: That's enough of that for tonight, I think. I'll be by the fire.
lines.arc_cracks: We went past a mine today, {player}, and I didn't stop to listen. First time in three years. My hands were shaking after.
lines.arc_turn: I've been asking it what it wants, {player}, as if the answer mattered. Maybe the question is what I want.
lines.arc_become: It's quiet in my head now, everybody, properly quiet. Lonely, some nights, but it's my quiet, and you're in it.
lines.arc_failed: I still go and listen, {player}. I tell myself it's only to find out. I don't know if that's true any more.
lines.alt_turn: I went down into the dark again last night, {player}, on my own. I said I was only checking, and that was a lie.
lines.alt_become: It talks and I listen, {player}, and I'm not sure where it ends and I begin. I'm telling you because I promised to say the worst first.
lines.g_roast_after: Still the most lost convoy I've ever driven with, everybody. I'd do every night run with you.
lines.g_after_wipe_after: Up we get, slowly, and hold on to each other. We go down together and we come up together, that's my rule now.
lines.g_toast_after: To you lot, the voices I chose. It's quiet in my head now, and you're the reason it isn't lonely. Iechyd da, my lovely lot.
lines.g_crew_after: This is my convoy now, everybody, for good. I don't need to talk into the dark any more.
g_quiet_line_after: Walked right past a cave tonight and didn't even slow down. Hummed a hymn instead, the whole thing.
Slept through the night, first time in years. Nothing woke me, nothing at all, and it was lovely.
g_loved_after: Thank you, bach, and I believe you. That's new for me, believing it.
That's kind, and I'll keep it. Not in the notebook, mind, just in my head.

history.open: Best I tell you now, {player}, so you don't hear it from somebody else. Something in the dark talks to me. It has since my first week, down in the Azurelode Mine.

options.reply: I always say the worst thing first. That way nobody can say I hid it. It's a rule I keep.
Probably, a bit, yes, and so am I. But I'm still the one driving, and I write everything down in case I'm not.
Ha, no, bach, terrible sense of humour. Worse than mine, and that's going some.

history.open: This was in my fist when I landed, {player}. The handset off my CB, cord snapped clean. Eight years of night runs out of Cardiff, and that was most of my conversation.

options.reply: Other drivers, mostly, at three in the morning. Handles, never names. Some of them I'd have called friends, and never once saw their faces.
I was, yes, and I was used to it. That's the trouble with lonely, you stop noticing. Eight years of it is good practice for talking to something.

history.open: My mam worked in a bakery in Barry, {player}, and sang in the chapel choir. She sang to me every night. She went into a home when I was forty one, and by the end she didn't know who I was. People say that makes this easier.

options.reply: No, it doesn't, you're right. Thank you for saying it. Most people nod and change the subject.
It is, yes, her hymns. Calon Lan mostly. I didn't realise I did it until somebody told me.

friend.open: You asked once what it says, {player}. Mostly it asks me to come deeper. And sometimes, at night, it hums my mam's hymns back to me. Nearly right, but not quite. Not a soul has heard that from me before you.

options.reply: It is, isn't it? And I still listen. That's the bit I'm ashamed of, and now you know it.

options.text: You don't have to go deeper.
options.reply: No, I don't, do I? It helps, hearing it from another mouth. Somebody who isn't in the dark.

sworn.open: For eight years I talked into a handset, {player}, and then into the dark. I'd rather talk to you now, from here on. That's as much as I've got, and it's all true.

options.reply: I know you are, bach. That's the difference, see. You actually answer.
Ha, never out, not with you. Over, and I'll wait for your reply.

reconciled.open: {name} and I had a proper sit down and sorted it out. All square now, and I wanted you to know.

options.reply: Ta, I feel better for it. I always do, after, and I always forget I will.

options.text: Did you put the kettle on?
options.reply: I did, twice. It helped, it always helps.
